# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2000

**Additional Appropriations Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance approves additional appropriations amounting to P355,533.00 for the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] to address funding shortages in the 2000 Annual Budget. It allocates funds from the First Quarter release of the Unprogrammed Fund for CY 2000 (Internal Revenue Allotment). The ordinance also incorporates Additional Appropriation No. 01 of 2000 as an additional part of the ordinance.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates P355,533.00 from the First Quarter release of Unprogrammed Fund for CY 2000 (Internal Revenue Allotment) to cover additional expenses of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]] and address funding shortages in the 2000 Annual Budget.
2.  **Section 2.** Incorporates Additional Appropriation No. 01 of 2000, prepared by the Honorable Mayor, as an additional part of this ordinance, referred to as "Annex A".
3.  **Section 3.** States that this ordinance takes effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Approved on August 21, 2000 in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
